law_name: Law No. 08/L-205 on Copyright and Related Rights (in force 27 October 2023; repealed Law No. 04/L-065 of 2011)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (counted from 1 January of the year after death; joint works from death of last surviving author; anonymous works publication + 70 years)
moral_rights: Moral rights protected without time limit (article numbers not found)
registration_required: No (the 2011 law removed deposit of copies with the Office; no registration requirement found; unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Copyright Office under the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports (Zyra e të Drejtës së Autorit) (unconfirmed)
notes: Link is the repealed 2011 law; the 2023 text was not seen. No confirmed Berne/TRIPS/WCT/WPPT membership found (a 2011 paper says WIPO admission is tied to UN membership). Body source predates the 2023 law. Anti-Piracy Task Force created by the 2023 law.
